_comment: E10 Zone 1 Lord Trial SFX audition brief (2026-08-09, GO ODYSSEY E10 ZONE 1 BEGINNER VILLAGE COMPLETE RPG JOURNEY, sections 32-34). Completely separate from the LOCKED 35-asset dialogue/BGM/ambience/SFX package (zone1_sound_design_lock.json) -- these 8 candidates must never be promoted to canonical runtime until the Owner explicitly approves them (Gate A). One considered candidate per category for this first pass (avoids dozens of near-duplicate files); more variants available on request for any specific one.
direction_note: Real/convincing Go-stone qualities, wood/stone board, restrained bell/gong, air movement, magical resonance, elegant energy movement, warm gold/teal fantasy tone. Explicitly avoid: swords, explosions, gunfire, monster growls, horror drones, heavy combat drums, generic casino sounds, generic mobile-game victory jingles.

sfx.label: LORD_CARD_REVEAL
sfx.prompt: A soft low magical whoosh as an ornate card reveals itself, followed by a single restrained warm bell chime, elegant and refined, no percussion, no drums, very short

sfx.label: LORD_CHALLENGE_CONFIRM
sfx.prompt: A short low wooden confirmation impact, like a firm hand press on a resonant wooden table, with a subtle warm resonance tail, no music, no percussion kit, very short

sfx.label: LORD_RITUAL_ENERGY
sfx.intended_trigger: Underscore for the 3-5s Lord Entrance Ritual
sfx.prompt: Elegant magical energy flowing and gently building, warm golden shimmer with a low teal undertone, restrained ambient texture, no percussion, gentle crescendo, Go-themed not battle-themed

sfx.label: GO_STONE_IMPACT
sfx.intended_trigger: The decisive stone lands at the end of the ritual -- the signature Lord Trial sound
sfx.prompt: A single Go stone placed decisively onto a resonant wooden board, clean sharp click with a warm wooden resonance tail, no music, no reverb wash, natural and convincing

sfx.label: LORD_TRIAL_SUCCESS
sfx.prompt: A short elegant magical success chime, warm bell and light stone resonance layered together, uplifting but restrained and premium, not a generic mobile game victory jingle, no percussion

sfx.label: LORD_TRIAL_FAILURE
sfx.prompt: A muted settling wood-and-stone resonance with a gently descending tone, restrained and contemplative rather than sad or punishing, no percussion, no horror drone, brief

sfx.label: ZONE_UNLOCK_CHIME
sfx.intended_trigger: Zone 2 awakens at the end of the Zone Unlock Reveal route animation
sfx.prompt: A clean bright magical chime marking a new area unlocking, warm gold tone resolving into teal, short natural decay, elegant and premium, not a generic mobile achievement jingle

sfx.label: ZONE_ROUTE_ENERGY
sfx.intended_trigger: Underneath the route-illumination travel animation, before the unlock chime lands
sfx.prompt: Quiet flowing magical energy traveling steadily along a path, soft shimmering texture with gentle forward motion, ambient and restrained, no percussion, resolves naturally into a bright chime
